title: Scale Solo #21 (koi)

extreme platform heels covered in the same scale texture, the shimmer continuing unbroken onto the shoe, extra long stiletto nails with the same iridescent shimmer at each tip.

MANDATORY pure pitch black void background only, absolutely NO studio backdrop NO texture NO grey NO gradient. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on every individual scale and shadow. Pattern density MAXIMUM — zero bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
